name: style-me-by-yanabana
description: Women's and men's personal styling, shoppable outfit previews, and separate capsule wardrobes.

interface.longDescription: Choose womenswear, menswear, or both, then explore three photo-based style directions for each category. Set your price preference and use your photo to preview a shoppable outfit. Find pieces in Accessible, Premium, Luxury, or mixed price ranges. Expand your look into 3 to 14 separate capsule wardrobes with outfit images and shopping links. Image editing and live product browsing must be available in the ChatGPT experience.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a style for work and find pieces in my price range.
Style me from my photo and find the pieces in my price range.
Build three separate capsule wardrobes around my style and budget.

publication.release_notes: Show the six supplied style photos in an interactive gallery with Accessible, Premium, Luxury, and Mix it up choices. Start each new styling chat with unselected visual choices unless explicitly supplied for that request, and keep picker state isolated between gallery instances. Use consistent 2:3 portrait framing for all six style photos. Preserve personalized outfit previews, verified shopping links, and 3 to 14 separate capsule wardrobes.
